faqs.q: Is SolarMatcher a solar installer itself?
faqs.a: No. SolarMatcher is a free matching service. We don't install solar panels ourselves — we pass your enquiry to a suitable local solar installer covering Wrexham, who will then contact you directly.

faqs.q: How much do solar panels cost in Wrexham?
faqs.a: Costs vary depending on your roof size, system type and whether you add battery storage. A local installer covering Wrexham will give you an accurate, no-obligation price once they understand your property.

faqs.q: Do I need planning permission for solar panels in Wrexham?
faqs.a: Most home solar installations in Wrexham fall under permitted development rights, but this can depend on your property type and whether it's listed or in a conservation area. Your installer can confirm what applies to your home.

faqs.q: How do I know if my roof is suitable for solar panels?
faqs.a: Suitability depends on factors like roof orientation, pitch, shading and structural condition. A local installer can assess this properly, but most Wrexham roof types can be considered as part of a free survey or initial conversation.

faqs.q: Can I add battery storage to my system?
faqs.a: Battery storage is something many installers can discuss alongside your solar panel enquiry, letting you store more of the electricity you generate for use later in the day. Whether it's right for your property is best discussed with the installer you're matched with.

faqs.q: How long does a solar panel installation take?
faqs.a: A typical domestic installation takes one to two days once scheduled, though timelines can vary based on system size and roof access.

faqs.q: What happens after I submit an enquiry?
faqs.a: Your enquiry is passed to a suitable local installer covering the Wrexham area. They'll typically get in touch within a few working days to discuss your property and a free, no-obligation quote.

faqs.q: Is it free to use SolarMatcher?
faqs.a: Yes. There's no cost or obligation to submit an enquiry, and no pressure to proceed with any quote you receive from a matched installer.
